title: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 4 (Distribution, etc. of Standard Personnel Management System)
(1) For efficient establishment of the electronic personnel management system, the Minister of the Interior and Safety may, after prior consultation with the heads of local governments and the chairpersons of local councils, develop and distribute a standard personnel management system suitable for the characteristics of local personnel systems. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017; November 30, 2021>
(2) Where a standard personnel management system is developed and distributed pursuant to paragraph (1), a local government shall use that system unless there is an unavoidable reason not to do so: Provided, That the head of a local government and the chairperson of a local council that cannot use the standard personnel management system may, after consultation with the Minister of the Interior and Safety, operate an agency personnel management system. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017; November 30, 2021>
(3) The head of a local government and the chairperson of a local council operating an agency personnel management system pursuant to the proviso to paragraph (2) shall take measures necessary for the establishment and operation of the electronic personnel management system, including ensuring data compatibility. <Amended on November 30, 2021>
(4) Other matters necessary for the management and operation of the standard personnel management system shall be prescribed by the Minister of the Interior and Safety after consultation with the heads of local governments and the chairpersons of local councils. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017; November 30, 2021>
